name: Wizoryx’s Instant Paste Featured Image
author: wizoryx

sections.description:
Stop saving screenshots to your desktop just to upload them as a Featured Image. Wizoryx’s Instant Paste Featured Image lets you paste any copied image or screenshot directly from your clipboard into WordPress—and automatically optimizes it on the fly.

Where You Can Paste

  1. Gutenberg Block Editor: Click the paste box or press Ctrl+V / Cmd+V right inside the Featured Image sidebar panel.
  2. All Posts & Pages List Table: Set featured images for dozens of posts in seconds using the Quick Paste Thumbnail column without even opening the editor.
  3. Classic Editor: Paste directly inside the Featured Image metabox.

Key Productivity & SEO Features (New in 1.0.1)

  • Automatic WebP Conversion: Automatically converts pasted PNG screenshots and JPEG images into lightweight .webp files using your server’s Imagick or GD engine (including full support for 8-bit indexed OS screenshots).
  • Custom Compression Quality: Control your WebP quality (10–100) to balance visual sharpness and fast page speed.
  • Smart Retina Screenshot Resizing: Automatically scales down oversized 4K/5K desktop screenshots to a customizable maximum width (default 2560px).
  • SEO-Friendly Filenames: Automatically renames generic clipboard blobs (image.png) using your post slug (e.g., my-post-slug-featured.webp).
  • Auto-Fill Alt Text: Automatically populates the uploaded image’s Alt Text attribute using the Post Title.
  • Server WebP Diagnostics: Built-in status indicator shows whether Imagick and GD WebP support are active on your hosting server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wizoryx-paste-featured-image folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate Wizoryx’s Instant Paste Featured Image through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Wizoryx Settings → Instant Paste Featured Image in your WordPress admin sidebar to configure WebP conversion, image quality, max width, and SEO options.
sections.faq:
How do I paste an image?

Take a screenshot (Win + Shift + S on Windows or Cmd + Ctrl + Shift + 4 on Mac) or right-click any image and select “Copy Image”. Then click the Paste button in the Featured Image box (or in the All Posts table) or press Ctrl+V / Cmd+V.

What happens if my server does not support WebP?

The plugin includes a built-in diagnostic check under Wizoryx Settings → Instant Paste Featured Image. If neither Imagick nor GD supports WebP on your server, the plugin safely falls back to saving the pasted image in its original PNG or JPEG format.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Added automatic server-side PNG/JPEG to WebP conversion via Imagick and GD.
  • Added dedicated settings panel under Wizoryx Settings → Instant Paste Featured Image.
  • Added customizable WebP compression quality and maximum image width resizing.
  • Added automatic SEO filename generation based on post slug and automatic Alt Text population.
  • Added Server WebP Engine Status diagnostics banner.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with clipboard paste support for Gutenberg, Classic Editor, and the All Posts / All Pages list table.
